explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/571 (Erdős–Simonovits rational exponents conjecture): for every rational α ∈ [1,2) there is a bipartite G with ex(n;G) ≍ n^α. The page still lists only partial results. The statement matches exactly, with G a bipartite graph on Fin q and ex(n;G) =Θ n^α; α = 1 is handled by trees. The solved tag rests on a linked Lean file (about 10k lines; I checked that it exists and reports only the standard axioms for erdos_571), not on the page. Faithful as a formalisation.
